title: Discord Bot token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 25-character first segment vs the 24 or 26 an 18- or 19-digit id encodes to and length: 37-character third segment vs the 27 or 38 observed. Twin of "Discord Bot token: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review. Negative twin of discord-bot-token-bot-authorization: length: 37-character third segment vs the 27 or 38 observed. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
